ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Oct-14-2004 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Janet Pond.
Petitioner: Lang Ping Deng, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Da tong Deng, and with Cantonese Interpreter: Sarah Deng, was sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Kenneth Da Tong Deng.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Sep-30-2004 Reset To Oct-14-04 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Patty Lee Hubble.
Petitioner: Lang Ping Deng, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for and with the Minor: Da Tong Deng and with Cantonese Interpreter: Sarah Deng, was swron and examined.
Lacks the Minor's mother consent and notice, the OSC for Change of Name of a Minor is continued to Oct. 14, 2004 at 9:00 a.m. in Dept. 218.
